description: This file contains unit tests for the OptionalType template class in the WPEFramework Core library, using Google Test framework. It tests default construction, assignment, comparison, and value retrieval for OptionalType with int and string types.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: Template class representing an optional value, supporting methods like IsSet(), Clear(), Value(), and operator overloads for comparison and assignment.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Method to retrieve the stored value.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Method to reset the OptionalType to an uninitialized state.
